package.name: robot_filtered_joint_state_broadcaster
package.description: Whole-body filtered joint state broadcaster. Reads raw position / velocity / effort state interfaces for every configured joint, applies a per-joint first-order IIR low-pass to velocity and effort (positions pass through unfiltered), and publishes a sensor_msgs/JointState on `/joint_states` (default) — replaces the standard joint_state_broadcaster on PVT launches.
